title: Multi-browser living-room E2E + rename visual→e2e (#98)
body: ## Summary Implements [#98](https://github.com/matemolnar8/cigster/issues/98): multi-context living-room E2E + rename visual→e2e. Also: platform snapshot dirs (`linux/` committed; `darwin/`/`win32/` gitignored) and `pnpm test:e2e:ui`. ## UI Mode note `pnpm test:e2e:ui` sets `E2E_UI=1` and **skips webServer** so the test list is instant (UI Mode otherwise hangs on “Loading…” during `convex init` with blank output). Start the app first: ```bash pnpm convex pnpm dev pnpm test:e2e:ui ``` ## Validation - [x] Living-room 10× flake check - [x] Docker landing goldens after `snapshots/linux/` move - [x] `--list` still reports 88 tests after visual/live project split
